## 安卓应用完整说明

### 一、应用架构

```text
FlowDesk BLE App (Android 12+ / API 31+)
│
├── 扫描层    BLE Scanner — 只找广播了专属 UUID 的设备
├── 连接层    BluetoothGatt — 建立 BLE 连接
├── 配对层    Challenge-Response — 专属协议验证
└── UI 层     Material Design 3 — 扫描/连接/配对/断开
```

### 二、配对协议逻辑

```text
板子 (Gemini S1)                    手机 (FlowDesk BLE App)
    │                                      │
    │  ① 广播专属 Service UUID             │
    │  12345678-...-abcdef0                │
    │                                      │
    │         ← 扫描（只认这个 UUID）──    │
    │                                      │
    │  ② 建立 BLE 连接 ──→                │
    │                                      │
    │  ③ 发送 Pair Request ──→            │
    │     [0x01][challenge:4字节]          │
    │                                      │
    │  ←── ④ 回复 Pair ACK ──             │
    │     [0x02][response:4字节]           │
    │     response = challenge XOR hash(key)│
    │                                      │
    │  ⑤ 验证 response                     │
    │     成功 → 配对成功，允许上网        │
    │     失败 → 配对失败，断开            │
    │                                      │
    │  ⑥ 心跳保活 ──→                     │
    │     [0x06][0x00]                     │
```

### 三、密钥算法

```java
// 板子和 App 共用同一个密钥
String PAIR_KEY = "GEMINI-S1-2026";

// App 端计算应答
int computeResponse(int challenge) {
    int h = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PAIR_KEY.length(); i++) {
        h = h * 31 + PAIR_KEY.charAt(i);
    }
    return challenge ^ h;
}
```

### 四、消息格式

```text
[CMD:1字节] [LEN:1字节] [DATA:0-32字节]

命令表:
  0x01  Pair Request   板子→App  (challenge 4字节)
  0x02  Pair ACK       App→板子  (response 4字节)
  0x03  Pair Fail      板子→App
  0x04  Net On         板子→App  (开启网络共享)
  0x05  Net Off        板子→App  (关闭网络共享)
  0x06  Heartbeat      双向      (保活)
```

### 五、具体实现步骤

#### 步骤 1：定义协议（板子 + App 共用）

```c
// dm_bt_protocol.h
#define SVC_UUID    "12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0"
#define CHAR_AUTH   "12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef1"
#define PAIR_KEY    "GEMINI-S1-2026"
```

#### 步骤 2：板子端 — BLE GATT Server

```c
// 1. 创建 GATT 服务，广播专属 UUID
// 2. 等待 App 连接
// 3. 收到 Pair Request → 发 challenge
// 4. 收到 Pair ACK → 验证 response
// 5. 验证通过 → 允许 PAN 连接
```

#### 步骤 3：App 端 — BLE GATT Client

```java
// 1. 扫描：只找广播了 SVC_UUID 的设备
// 2. 连接：connectGatt()
// 3. 发现服务：找到 CHAR_AUTH 特征
// 4. 配对：发送 Pair Request，等待 challenge
// 5. 计算 response 并回复
// 6. 收到成功/失败通知
```

#### 步骤 4：网络共享

```c
// 配对成功后，板子发起 PAN 连接
bttool connect PAN <手机MAC> 1 1
renew bt-pan
// 手机蓝牙网络共享 → 板子获得 IP → 上网
```

### 六、Android 端核心代码

```java
// 扫描（只认专属 UUID）
ScanCallback scanCallback = new ScanCallback() {
    public void onScanResult(int type, ScanResult result) {
        List<UUID> uuids = result.getScanRecord().getServiceUuids();
        if (uuids == null || !uuids.toString().contains("12345678")) return;
        // 加入设备列表
    }
};

// 配对计算
int computeResponse(int challenge) {
    int h = 0;
    for (char c : "GEMINI-S1-2026".toCharArray()) h = h * 31 + c;
    return challenge ^ h;
}

// 发送 ACK
ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(6).order(LITTLE_ENDIAN);
buf.put((byte) 0x02);  // CMD_PAIR_ACK
buf.put((byte) 4);
buf.putInt(computeResponse(challenge));
gatt.writeCharacteristic(authChar, buf.array());
```

### 七、Material Design 3 UI

```text
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│  FlowDesk BLE        (橙色) │  ← MaterialToolbar
├─────────────────────────────┤
│ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ 就绪                     │ │  ← MaterialCardView
│ │ 只显示专属设备            │ │
│ └─────────────────────────┘ │
│ [扫描] [连接] [配对] [断开]  │  ← MaterialButton
│ ┌─────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ 设备列表                 │ │
│ │ Device1 [MAC]           │ │
│ │ Device2 [MAC]           │ │
│ └─────────────────────────┘ │
└─────────────────────────────┘

配对动画:
┌─────────────────┐
│    ╭───────╮    │
│    │  ◉    │    │  ← ProgressBar (M3)
│    ╰───────╯    │
│    配对中...     │
│  ✓ 配对成功!    │  ← 绿色
└─────────────────┘
```

### 八、文件清单

| 文件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `build.gradle` | AGP 8.1.4 + compileSdk 32 |
| `settings.gradle` | 仓库配置 |
| `AndroidManifest.xml` | BLE 权限声明 |
| `MainActivity.java` | 扫描 + 连接 + 配对协议 |
| `activity_main.xml` | MD3 布局 + 配对动画 |
| `themes.xml` | MD3 主题 |
| `colors.xml` | MD3 色板 |

### 九、构建命令

```bash
cd C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\flowdeskgeminis1
gradlew clean build
```

APK 在 `app\build\outputs\apk\release\`。

/*
 * dm_bt_protocol.h — Gemini-S1 BLE pairing protocol
 * Dedicated protocol for App Connect (not open to all devices)
 */

#ifndef DM_BT_PROTOCOL_H
#define DM_BT_PROTOCOL_H

/* ── 专属 Service UUID（只认这个） ───────────────────────── */
#define DM_BT_SVC_UUID      "12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0"
#define DM_BT_CHAR_AUTH     "12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef1"
#define DM_BT_CHAR_CMD      "12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef2"
#define DM_BT_CHAR_STATUS   "12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef3"

/* ── 配对密钥（板子和 App 共享） ─────────────────────────── */
#define DM_BT_PAIR_KEY      "GEMINI-S1-2026"
#define DM_BT_PAIR_KEY_LEN  14

/* ── 协议命令 ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define DM_BT_CMD_PAIR_REQ   0x01  /* App -> Board: 请求配对 */
#define DM_BT_CMD_PAIR_ACK   0x02  /* Board -> App: 配对确认 */
#define DM_BT_CMD_PAIR_FAIL  0x03  /* Board -> App: 配对失败 */
#define DM_BT_CMD_NET_ON     0x04  /* Board -> App: 开启网络共享 */
#define DM_BT_CMD_NET_OFF    0x05  /* Board -> App: 关闭网络共享 */
#define DM_BT_CMD_HEARTBEAT  0x06  /* 心跳保活 */

/* ── 消息格式 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
/*
 * [CMD:1B] [LEN:1B] [DATA:0-32B]
 * 例: 01 0E GEMINI-S1-2026
 */

/* ── 配对验证 ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* 简单 challenge-response:
 * Board 发: DM_BT_CMD_PAIR_REQ + random 4B challenge
 * App 回:  challenge XOR key hash + DM_BT_CMD_PAIR_ACK
 */

#endif /* DM_BT_PROTOCOL_H */

```kotlin
package com.lrc.flowdesk.ble

import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java.util.UUID

object BleProtocol {
    val SERVICE_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0")
    val CHAR_AUTH: UUID = UUID.fromString("...abcdef1")
    val CHAR_CMD: UUID = ...
    val CHAR_STATUS: UUID = ...
    val CCCD_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb")
    const val PAIR_KEY = "GEMINI-S1-2026"
    const val CMD_PAIR_REQ = 0x01
    ...
    fun keyHash(): Int { var h = 0; for (c in PAIR_KEY) h = h * 31 + c.code; return h }
    fun computeResponse(challenge: Int): Int = challenge xor keyHash()
    fun buildPairAck(challenge: Int): ByteArray = ByteBuffer.allocate(6).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).put(CMD_PAIR_ACK.toByte()).put(4).putInt(computeResponse(challenge)).array()
    fun buildPairRequest(): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(CMD_PAIR_REQ.toByte(), 0)
    fun buildHeartbeat(): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(CMD_HEARTBEAT.toByte(), 0)
    data class Message(val cmd: Int, val payload: ByteArray)
    fun parse(data: ByteArray?): Message? { if (data == null || data.size < 2) return null; val len = data[1].toInt() and 0xFF; val payload = if (len <= data.size - 2) data.copyOfRange(2, 2 + len) else data.copyOfRange(2, data.size); return Message(data[0].toInt() and 0xFF, payload) }
    fun challengeOf(msg: Message): Int? = if (msg.payload.size >= 4) ByteBuffer.wrap(msg.payload).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).int else null
}
```

```kotlin
private class GattQueue(private val gatt: BluetoothGatt, private val onDone: (String?) -> Unit) {
    private val ops = ArrayDeque<GattOp>()
    private var busy = false
    sealed class GattOp {

    }
    fun onComplete(error: String? = null) { ... busy=false; if (error!=null) onDone(error); runNext() }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.lrc.flowdesk.ble

import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java.util.UUID

/**
 * Gemini S1 专用 BLE 配对协议（与板端 dm_bt_protocol.h 对齐）。
 *
 * 报文格式：[CMD:1B][LEN:1B][DATA:0..32B]（多字节整数使用小端序）
 */
object BleProtocol {
    /** 专属 Service UUID：扫描时只认这个。 */
    val SERVICE_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0")

    /** 配对特征：板子下发 Pair Request（notify），App 回 Pair ACK（write）。 */
    val CHAR_AUTH: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef1")

    /** 命令特征：App -> 板子（心跳、联网状态等）。 */
    val CHAR_CMD: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef2")

    /** 状态特征：板子 -> App（Net On/Off、配对结果等）。 */
    val CHAR_STATUS: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef3")

    val CCCD_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb")

    /** 与板端共用的配对密钥。 */
    const val PAIR_KEY: String = "GEMINI-S1-2026"

    const val CMD_PAIR_REQ = 0x01
    const val CMD_PAIR_ACK = 0x02
    const val CMD_PAIR_FAIL = 0x03
    const val CMD_NET_ON = 0x04
    const val CMD_NET_OFF = 0x05
    const val CMD_HEARTBEAT = 0x06

    const val MAX_PAYLOAD = 32

    /** 密钥哈希：与板端 h = h * 31 + (uint8_t)k[i] 的小端 32 位溢出语义一致。 */
    fun keyHash(): Int {
        var h = 0
        for (c in PAIR_KEY) h = h * 31 + c.code
        return h
    }

    /** response = challenge XOR hash(PAIR_KEY) */
    fun computeResponse(challenge: Int): Int = challenge xor keyHash()

    fun buildPairRequest(): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(CMD_PAIR_REQ.toByte(), 0)

    fun buildPairAck(challenge: Int): ByteArray =
        ByteBuffer.allocate(6).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            .put(CMD_PAIR_ACK.toByte())
            .put(4)
            .putInt(computeResponse(challenge))
            .array()

    fun buildHeartbeat(): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(CMD_HEARTBEAT.toByte(), 0)

    data class Message(val cmd: Int, val payload: ByteArray)

    fun parse(data: ByteArray?): Message? {
        if (data == null || data.size < 2) return null
        val len = data[1].toInt() and 0xFF
        val end = (2 + len).coerceAtMost(data.size)
        return Message(data[0].toInt() and 0xFF, data.copyOfRange(2, end))
    }

    fun readChallenge(msg: Message): Int? {
        if (msg.payload.size < 4) return null
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(msg.payload, 0, 4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).int
    }

    fun commandName(cmd: Int): String = when (cmd) {
        CMD_PAIR_REQ -> "Pair Request"
        CMD_PAIR_ACK -> "Pair ACK"
        CMD_PAIR_FAIL -> "Pair Fail"
        CMD_NET_ON -> "Net On"
        CMD_NET_OFF -> "Net Off"
        CMD_HEARTBEAT -> "Heartbeat"
        else -> "0x%02X".format(cmd)
    }

    fun hex(data: ByteArray?): String = data?.joinToString(" ") { "%02X".format(it) } ?: ""
}
```

```kotlin
private fun handleNotification(uuid: UUID, value: ByteArray) {
    val msg = BleProtocol.parse(value) ?: return
    log("收到 ${BleProtocol.commandName(msg.cmd)} ${BleProtocol.hex(value)}")
    when (msg.cmd) {
        BleProtocol.CMD_PAIR_REQ -> {
            val challenge = BleProtocol.readChallenge(msg)
            if (challenge == null) { log("Pair Request 数据长度不足"); return }
            if (_state.value.paired) { log("已配对，忽略重复请求"); return }
            val target = authChar ?: cmdChar ?: statusChar
            if (target == null) { fail("没有可写入的配对特征"); return }
            _state.update { it.copy(connState = ConnState.PAIRING, pairingPhase = PairingPhase.PAIRING, statusText = "正在配对…", hint = "challenge=0x%08X".format(challenge)) }
            pendingPairAck = true
            ackUuid = target.uuid
            handler.removeCallbacks(pairTimeout)
            handler.postDelayed(pairTimeout, PAIR_TIMEOUT_MS)
            writeCharacteristic(target, BleProtocol.buildPairAck(challenge), "Pair ACK")
        }
        BleProtocol.CMD_PAIR_FAIL -> onPairFailed("板子返回配对失败")
        BleProtocol.CMD_NET_ON -> { ... }
        BleProtocol.CMD_NET_OFF -> { ... }
        BleProtocol.CMD_HEARTBEAT -> { }
        BleProtocol.CMD_PAIR_ACK -> { log("收到 ACK") }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
private class GattQueue(private val gatt: BluetoothGatt, private val onError: (String?) -> Unit) {
    sealed class Op {
        data class WriteCharacteristic(val characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic, val value: ByteArray, val label: String, val writeType: Int = BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT) : Op()
        data class WriteDescriptor(val descriptor: BluetoothGattDescriptor, val value: ByteArray, val label: String) : Op()
    }
    private val pending = ArrayDeque<Op>()
    private var busy = false
    private var currentLabel: String? = null

    fun enqueue(op: Op) { pending.addLast(op); pump() }
    fun onOperationFinished(error: String?) {
        busy = false
        currentLabel?.let { if (error != null) onError("$it：$error") }
        currentLabel = null
        pump()
    }
    private fun pump() {
        if (busy) return
        val op = pending.removeFirstOrNull() ?: return
        busy = true
        currentLabel = op.label
        val ok = when (op) {
            is Op.WriteCharacteristic -> writeChar(op)
            is Op.WriteDescriptor -> writeDesc(op)
        }
        if (!ok) { busy = false; currentLabel = null; onError("${op.label}：GATT 忙或参数无效"); pump() }
    }
    private fun writeChar(op: Op.WriteCharacteristic): Boolean = try {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            gatt.writeCharacteristic(op.characteristic, op.value, op.writeType) == BluetoothStatusCodes.SUCCESS
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            op.characteristic.value = op.value
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            op.characteristic.writeType = op.writeType
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            gatt.writeCharacteristic(op.characteristic)
        }
    } catch (e: SecurityException) { false }
    ...
}
```

```
package com.lrc.flowdesk.ble

import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.ByteOrder
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.UUID

/**
 * Gemini S1 专用 BLE 配对协议，与板端 dm_bt_protocol.h 保持一致。
 *
 * 报文格式：[CMD:1B][LEN:1B][DATA:0..32B]，多字节整数使用小端序。
 * 板子：Pair Request(0x01, challenge) -> App；App：Pair ACK(0x02, response) -> 板子。
 * response = challenge XOR hash(PAIR_KEY)
 */
object BleProtocol {
    val SERVICE_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0")
    val CHAR_AUTH: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef1")
    val CHAR_CMD: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef2")
    val CHAR_STATUS: UUID = UUID.fromString("12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef3")
    val CCCD_UUID: UUID = UUID.fromString("00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb")

    const val PAIR_KEY = "GEMINI-S1-2026"

    const val CMD_PAIR_REQ = 0x01
    const val CMD_PAIR_ACK = 0x02
    const val CMD_PAIR_FAIL = 0x03
    const val CMD_NET_ON = 0x04
    const val CMD_NET_OFF = 0x05
    const val CMD_HEARTBEAT = 0x06

    fun keyHash(): Int {
        var h = 0
        for (c in PAIR_KEY) {
            h = h * 31 + c.code
        }
        return h
    }

    fun computeResponse(challenge: Int): Int = challenge xor keyHash()

    fun buildPairRequest(): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(CMD_PAIR_REQ.toByte(), 0)

    fun buildPairAck(challenge: Int): ByteArray {
        return ByteBuffer.allocate(6).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            .put(CMD_PAIR_ACK.toByte())
            .put(4)
            .putInt(computeResponse(challenge))
            .array()
    }

    fun buildHeartbeat(): ByteArray = byteArrayOf(CMD_HEARTBEAT.toByte(), 0)

    data class Message(val cmd: Int, val payload: ByteArray)

    fun parse(data: ByteArray?): Message? {
        if (data == null || data.size < 2) return null
        val len = data[1].toInt() and 0xFF
        val end = minOf(2 + len, data.size)
        return Message(data[0].toInt() and 0xFF, data.copyOfRange(2, end))
    }

    fun readChallenge(msg: Message): Int? {
        if (msg.payload.size < 4) return null
        return ByteBuffer.wrap(msg.payload, 0, 4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).int
    }

    fun commandName(cmd: Int): String {
        return when (cmd) {
            CMD_PAIR_REQ -> "PairRequest"
            CMD_PAIR_ACK -> "PairAck"
            CMD_PAIR_FAIL -> "PairFail"
            CMD_NET_ON -> "NetOn"
            CMD_NET_OFF -> "NetOff"
            CMD_HEARTBEAT -> "Heartbeat"
            else -> String.format(Locale.US, "0x%02X", cmd)
        }
    }

    fun hex(data: ByteArray?): String {
        if (data == null) return ""
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        for (b in data) {
            sb.append(String.format(Locale.US, "%02X ", b.toInt() and 0xFF))
        }
        return sb.toString().trim()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import java.util.UUID

enum class ConnState { IDLE, SCANNING, CONNECTING, DISCOVERING, READY, PAIRING, PAIRED, ERROR }
enum class PairingPhase { NONE, PAIRING, SUCCESS, FAIL }

data class BleDevice(val name: String, val address: String, val rssi: Int)

data class BleUiState(
    val connState: ConnState = ConnState.IDLE,
    val statusText: String = "就绪",
    val hint: String = "只显示广播了专属 Service UUID 的 Gemini S1 设备",
    val devices: List<BleDevice> = emptyList(),
    val selectedAddress: String? = null,
    val connectedAddress: String? = null,
    val paired: Boolean = false,
    val networkShared: Boolean = false,
    val pairingPhase: PairingPhase = PairingPhase.NONE,
    val logs: List<String> = emptyList(),
)

@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class BleController(context: Context) {
    private val appContext: Context = context.applicationContext
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val adapter: BluetoothAdapter? =
        appContext.getSystemService(BluetoothManager::class.java)?.adapter

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(BleUiState())
    val state: StateFlow<BleUiState> = _state.asStateFlow()

    private var scanning = false
    private var closed = false
    private var gatt: BluetoothGatt? = null
    private var authChar: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private var cmdChar: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private var statusChar: BluetoothGattCharacteristic? = null
    private var queue: GattQueue? = null
    private var pendingPairAck = false
    private var ackCharUuid: UUID? = null
    private val scanResults = LinkedHashMap<String, BleDevice>()

    private val scanTimeout = Runnable {
        if (scanning) {
            stopScan()
            log("扫描超时，已自动停止")
        }
    }

    private val pairTimeout = Runnable { onPairTimeout() }

    private val heartbeat = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            if (closed || !_state.value.paired) return
            val target = cmdChar ?: authChar
            if (target != null) {
                writeCharacteristic(target, BleProtocol.buildHeartbeat(), "Heartbeat")
            }
            handler.postDelayed(this, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS)
        }
    }

    private val scanCallback = object : ScanCallback() {
        override fun onScanResult(callbackType: Int, result: ScanResult) {
            val device = result.device ?: return
            val recordUuids = result.scanRecord?.serviceUuids
            if (recordUuids != null && recordUuids.isNotEmpty()) {
                var matched = false
                for (p in recordUuids) {
                    if (p.uuid == BleProtocol.SERVICE_UUID) { matched = true; break }
                }
                if (!matched) return
            }
            val address = try { device.address } catch (e: SecurityException) { return }
            val name = try { device.name } catch (e: SecurityException) { null } ?: "Gemini S1"
            scanResults[address] = BleDevice(name, address, result.rssi)
            val list = scanResults.values.sortedByDescending { it.rssi }
            _state.update { it.copy(devices = list) }
        }

        override fun onScanFailed(errorCode: Int) = onMain {
            scanning = false
            handler.removeCallbacks(scanTimeout)
            fail("扫描失败，错误码 " + errorCode)
        }
    }

    private val gattCallback = object : BluetoothGattCallback() {
        override fun onConnectionStateChange(g: BluetoothGatt, status: Int, newState: Int) = onMain {
            if (newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_CONNECTED) {
                _state.update {
                    it.copy(
                        connState = ConnState.DISCOVERING,
                        statusText = "已连接，正在发现服务…",
                        hint = "查找专属 GATT 服务与 AUTH 特征",
                        connectedAddress = try { g.device.address } catch (e: SecurityException) { null }
                    )
                }
                log("GATT 已连接")
                try { g.discoverServices() } catch (e: SecurityException) { fail("发现服务失败：蓝牙权限被拒绝") }
            } else if (newState == BluetoothProfile.STATE_DISCONNECTED) {
                onDisconnected(status)
            }
        }

        override fun onServicesDiscovered(g: BluetoothGatt, status: Int) = onMain {
            if (status != BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) {
                fail("发现服务失败，状态码 " + status)
                closeGatt()
                return@onMain
            }
            val service = g.getService(BleProtocol.SERVICE_UUID)
            if (service == null) {
                fail("没有找到专属 Service UUID，请确认连接的是 Gemini S1")
                closeGatt()
                return@onMain
            }
            authChar = service.getCharacteristic(BleProtocol.CHAR_AUTH)
            cmdChar = service.getCharacteristic(BleProtocol.CHAR_CMD)
            statusChar = service.getCharacteristic(BleProtocol.CHAR_STATUS)
            if (authChar == null) {
                fail("专属服务缺少 AUTH 特征")
                closeGatt()
                return@onMain
            }
            queue = GattQueue(g, handler) { message -> if (message != null) log("GATT: " + message) }
            enableNotifications(g, authChar)
            enableNotifications(g, cmdChar)
            enableNotifications(g, statusChar)
            _state.update {
                it.copy(
                    connState = ConnState.READY,
                    statusText = "服务就绪，可以配对",
                    hint = "等待板子下发 challenge，或点「配对」主动请求"
                )
            }
            log("服务发现完成，已订阅通知")
        }

        override fun onCharacteristicChanged(g: BluetoothGatt, c: BluetoothGattCharacteristic, value: ByteArray) = onMain {
            handleNotification(c.uuid, value)
        }

        override fun onCharacteristicChanged(g: BluetoothGatt, c: BluetoothGattCharacteristic) = onMain {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            handleNotification(c.uuid, c.value ?: ByteArray(0))
        }

        override fun onCharacteristicWrite(g: BluetoothGatt, c: BluetoothGattCharacteristic, status: Int) = onMain {
            if (pendingPairAck && c.uuid == ackCharUuid) {
                pendingPairAck = false
                handler.removeCallbacks(pairTimeout)
                if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) onPairSuccess() else onPairFailed("ACK 写入失败，状态码 " + status)
            }
            queue?.onOperationFinished(if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) null else "写入失败，状态码 " + status)
        }

        override fun onDescriptorWrite(g: BluetoothGatt, d: BluetoothGattDescriptor, status: Int) = onMain {
            queue?.onOperationFinished(if (status == BluetoothGatt.GATT_SUCCESS) null else "订阅失败，状态码 " + status)
        }
```

```kotlin
    private class GattQueue(
        private val gatt: BluetoothGatt,
        private val onMessage: (String?) -> Unit
    ) {
        sealed class Op {
            data class WriteCharacteristic(
                val characteristic: BluetoothGattCharacteristic,
                val value: ByteArray,
                val label: String,
                val writeType: Int = BluetoothGattCharacteristic.WRITE_TYPE_DEFAULT
            ) : Op()

            data class WriteDescriptor(
                val descriptor: BluetoothGattDescriptor,
                val value: ByteArray,
                val label: String
            ) : Op()
        }

        private val pending = ArrayDeque<Op>()
        private var busy = false
        private var currentLabel: String? = null

        fun enqueue(op: Op) {
            pending.addLast(op)
            pump()
        }

        fun onOperationFinished(error: String?) {
            busy = false
            currentLabel = null
            if (error != null) onMessage(error)
            pump()
        }

        private fun pump() {
            if (busy) return
            val op = pending.removeFirstOrNull() ?: return
            busy = true
            currentLabel = op.label
            val ok = when (op) {
                is Op.WriteCharacteristic -> writeCharacteristic(op)
                is Op.WriteDescriptor -> writeDescriptor(op)
            }
            if (!ok) {
                busy = false
                currentLabel = null
                onMessage(op.label + "：GATT 忙或写入被拒绝")
                pump()
            }
        }

        private fun writeCharacteristic(op: Op.WriteCharacteristic): Boolean {
            return try {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                    gatt.writeCharacteristic(op.characteristic, op.value, op.writeType) == BluetoothStatusCodes.SUCCESS
                } else {
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    op.characteristic.value = op.value
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    op.characteristic.writeType = op.writeType
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    gatt.writeCharacteristic(op.characteristic)
                }
            } catch (e: SecurityException) {
                false
            }
        }

        private fun writeDescriptor(op: Op.WriteDescriptor): Boolean {
            return try {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                    gatt.writeDescriptor(op.descriptor, op.value) == BluetoothStatusCodes.SUCCESS
                } else {
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    op.descriptor.value = op.value
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    gatt.writeDescriptor(op.descriptor)
                }
            } catch (e: SecurityException) {
                false
            }
        }
    }
```

## BLE 协议（与板端 dm_bt_protocol.h 对齐）

专属 Service UUID（扫描只认这个）：

~~~
Service : 12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0
AUTH    : 12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef1   板子 -> App: Pair Request (notify)
                                                   App -> 板子: Pair ACK     (write)
CMD     : 12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef2    App -> 板子: 配对请求 / 心跳
STATUS  : 12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef3    板子 -> App: Net On / Net Off
CCCD    : 00002902-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb
~~~

报文格式：[CMD:1B][LEN:1B][DATA:0..32B]，多字节整数小端序。

命令：

~~~
0x01 Pair Request   板子 -> App   DATA = challenge(4B, LE)
0x02 Pair ACK       App -> 板子   DATA = response(4B, LE)
0x03 Pair Fail      板子 -> App
0x04 Net On         板子 -> App   开启网络共享
0x05 Net Off        板子 -> App   关闭网络共享
0x06 Heartbeat      双向         保活
~~~

配对密钥与算法（与板端 dm_bt_pair.c 完全一致）：

~~~
PAIR_KEY = "GEMINI-S1-2026"
h = 0
for (c in PAIR_KEY) h = h * 31 + c        // 32 位有符号整数溢出语义，等价于 uint32_t 回绕
response = challenge XOR h
~~~

## App 行为

1. 权限：BLUETOOTH_SCAN（neverForLocation）+ BLUETOOTH_CONNECT（Android 12+「附近的设备」）。
2. 扫描：ScanFilter 只匹配专属 Service UUID，12 秒后自动停止；列表去重后按 RSSI 排序。
3. 连接：BluetoothGatt.connectGatt(TRANSPORT_LE) → discoverServices()。
4. 订阅：找到 AUTH / CMD / STATUS 后逐个写 CCCD 打开 notify（GATT 操作串行队列）。
5. 配对：
   - 收到板子下发的 Pair Request（0x01 + challenge）后计算 response 并写 Pair ACK（0x02）；
   - 也可以点「配对」主动发送 [0x01][0x00] 请求，等待板子下发 challenge；
   - 写入成功 → 绿色「配对成功」动画；收到 0x03 或超时 → 红色失败动画。
6. 心跳：配对成功后每 5 秒向 CMD 写 [0x06][0x00]。
7. 联网：收到 Net On / Net Off（0x04 / 0x05）时更新界面状态；App 引导用户打开系统「蓝牙网络共享」，由板端 bttool 以 PAN 方式连接手机，手机侧普通 App 无权限直接开关共享。

## Android 端已实现的 BLE 行为（可直接对照实现板端 GATT Server）

Service UUID: 12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef0
特征（Android 端都会订阅 notify）：
  AUTH   12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef1   属性建议：READ | WRITE | NOTIFY
  CMD    12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef2   属性建议：WRITE | NOTIFY（可选）
  STATUS 12345678-1234-5678-1234-56789abcdef3   属性建议：NOTIFY

报文：[CMD:1B][LEN:1B][DATA:0..32B]；多字节整数小端序。

板端 GATT Server 需要提供的最小实现：

1. 广播里带上 Service UUID（只放在 scan response 里 Android 端可能扫不到）。
2. Client 订阅 AUTH 的 CCCD 后（或连接建立后延迟 200ms），生成 4 字节随机 challenge，
   在 AUTH 上 notify：01 04 <challenge:4B LE>。
3. 收到 AUTH 写入 0x02（Pair ACK）：
   - 校验 LEN=4，取 response（4B LE）；
   - h = 0; for (i=0;i<14;i++) h = h*31 + (uint8_t)"GEMINI-S1-2026"[i];   // uint32_t 回绕
   - expected = challenge XOR h;
   - response == expected：标记 paired，回 0x04 Net On（STATUS 或 AUTH notify）；允许 PAN；
   - 否则回 0x03 Pair Fail。
4. 收到 AUTH/CMD 写入 0x01（Pair Request，App 主动请求）：重新生成 challenge 并 notify 01 04 ...。
5. 收到 0x06（Heartbeat）：忽略或回心跳均可；Android 端配对成功后每 5s 发一次。
6. 配对失败/超时：Android 端 10 秒后显示失败，可重试；板端可保留原 challenge 或重新生成（建议每次重新生成）。

## 安卓端实现内容

| 层 | 实现 |
|---|---|
| 扫描 | ScanFilter 只认 `12345678-...-abcdef0`，12 秒自动停止、去重、按 RSSI 排序 |
| 连接 | `connectGatt(TRANSPORT_LE)` → `discoverServices()` |
| 订阅 | 发现 AUTH/CMD/STATUS 后写 CCCD 打开 notify，GATT 写操作串行队列 |
| 配对 | 收到 `01 04 <challenge LE>` → 计算 `challenge XOR hash("GEMINI-S1-2026")` → 回 `02 04 <response LE>`；也可点「配对」主动发 `01 00`；失败/10 秒超时红色动画 |
| 心跳 | 配对成功后每 5 秒向 CMD 写 `06 00` |
| 联网 | 显示手机网络/蓝牙网络共享状态，NetOn/NetOff 通知更新 UI，一键跳系统网络共享设置（普通 App 无权限代码开关共享，需手动开） |
| UI | MD3 橙色主题：状态卡、扫描/连接/配对/断开四按钮、设备列表、联网卡、调试日志、配对 Progress/✓/✗ 动画 |
| 权限 | Android 12+ `BLUETOOTH_SCAN`(neverForLocation)+`BLUETOOTH_CONNECT`，首次启动自动申请 |

核心文件：[BleProtocol.kt](C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/flowdesk/app/src/main/java/com/lrc/flowdesk/ble/BleProtocol.kt)、[BleController.kt](C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/flowdesk/app/src/main/java/com/lrc/flowdesk/ble/BleController.kt)、[FlowDeskScreen.kt](C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/flowdesk/app/src/main/java/com/lrc/flowdesk/ui/FlowDeskScreen.kt)、[Tethering.kt](C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/flowdesk/app/src/main/java/com/lrc/flowdesk/net/Tethering.kt)，协议说明见 [README.md](C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/flowdesk/README.md)。
